key_idea: Print bits 3..0 of each of the four digits as rows, placing them in columns 1, 3, 7 and 9 of a 9-character line.
sketch: For bit b from 3 down to 0 build a 9-space string and set positions 0, 2, 6, 8 to '*' if the corresponding digit has bit b set, else '.'. O(1). Pitfalls: the gap between hours and minutes is three spaces, top row is the highest bit, and no trailing whitespace.
